//: Copy to ~/.claude-dashboard/watchers.json and fill in real IDs. This file is a template with placeholders only. The bot token is read from an env var (see 'botToken'), never stored here.

watchers.name: mentions
watchers.//channels: Slack channel IDs (the bot must be invited to each). Fail-closed: empty = the watcher does not run.
watchers.//trigger: What makes a thread worth looking at. Only 'mention' is implemented: a thread qualifies when one of these users is @-mentioned anywhere in it (including a late reply). Required, non-empty.
watchers.//intents: Your intent -> skill map. The classifier matches a qualifying thread to ONE named intent (or none); the skill comes from this map, not from the model. Empty list = the model picks a skill freely (looser).

intents.name: pr-review
intents.description: asked to review a pull request

intents.name: bug
intents.description: a bug, failure, or regression to investigate

watchers.//poll: How often to poll (seconds; floored at 30). A persistent cursor backfills anything missed while the machine was asleep.
watchers.//action.preferCheckout: When a repo is checked out under more than one parent folder, prefer the one whose parent folder has this name. Repos are auto-discovered from git remotes under the codebase dir.
watchers.//action.cwd: Optional fallback target folder. A candidate's cwd is normally derived from a PR link in the message; if none resolves, this folder is used so the candidate is still launchable. Omit to leave such candidates without a cwd.

watchers.//: A 'dm' watcher: forward or DM a message to the bot and it becomes a candidate — no channel and no @mention needed. Needs extra Slack scopes 'im:history' + 'im:read', and App Home -> Messages Tab enabled + 'Allow users to send messages' so the bot can receive DMs. No 'channels' field: the bot<->user DM is resolved at runtime.
watchers.name: forward-to-me

intents.name: bug
intents.description: a bug, failure, or regression to investigate
